<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-045:40918825821:d2997ab8 -->
## Verified resolution — related rendering/theme batch

The owning view helper now changes only the receiver, never its superview; controller theming remains explicitly scoped. All three original acceptance requirements are verified:

1. Opposite/inherited native siblings, independent updates/removal and explicit parent/controller ownership.
2. Actual Compose/native sheet and genuine iPad popover with transparent CalendarViewHost day content; child changes do not rewrite any ancestor.
3. Fresh simulator-wide dark/light changes, observed inherited UIKit traits and isolated explicit overrides, with the original system appearance restored.

Fresh verification: [40918825821](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40918825821), immutable `d2997ab8f517f79555c78bc3ff6cdcbf7397d381`: the independent system method passed **1/1**, command exit **0**, 96.96 seconds. All **876** before/after inputs match exact Git; native TeamCity/JUnit agree, Worker terminates, runtime/binary/install identity and owned application cleanup pass. Three completed unchanged owner methods from [40903805198](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40903805198), plus the unchanged component ownership checks, are explicitly reused, not reported as fresh runs. Their owning production/host/method bytes are bound unchanged through `6f7e6414`.

**The overall workflow remains failed because its independent vector pixel member fails; #139 remains open.** That unrelated failure does not block this verified theme subset. The historical interrupted run remains failed. The existing RGB/alpha heuristic is retained; this closure is not universal device, accessibility, profiling, ABI, security or release certification. No packages, releases, deployment or Pages were created.
